Cover the Whole Party

Our 20 ft x 20 ft white pole tent covers a full dining or seating area, making it a strong choice for larger backyard parties, community events, fundraisers, and family gatherings.

Choose self-serve for $300 — you set it up and take it down yourself — or have our team handle setup and takedown for $400. The tent uses stakes and guy ropes, so it requires a stakeable grass surface with enough clear space around the perimeter.

This is an open-sided pole tent, not an enclosed event tent. It must stay anchored at all times and must not be used in winds above 38 km/h, storms, unsafe weather, or on unsuitable surfaces. Final availability, delivery, setup approval, and pricing are confirmed manually before booking.
